standard_prerequisites.name: Finitely oscillation stable families and the Ramsey property up to a precision
standard_prerequisites.statement: A finite family of functions is finitely oscillation stable when for every finite set of group elements and every precision some translate makes all the functions constant up to that precision; the article also says that a structure has the Ramsey property up to a precision for colorings in a family when for every finite substructure there is a copy of it on which every coloring of the family is constant up to that precision. The author's own definitions are the ones used by the counted statement and proof.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted proposition is the quantitative bridge between the analytic condition on families of functions and the combinatorial condition on colorings.

standard_prerequisites.name: The oscillation stability proposition in its Ramsey form
standard_prerequisites.statement: The article's earlier proposition states that for a Fraisse structure and a unital left-invariant closed star-subalgebra, a finite set of finite colorings is finitely oscillation stable exactly when for every finite substructure there is a copy on which every coloring of the set is constant. The author's own statement is the one used by the counted proof.
standard_prerequisites.use: The forward direction of the counted proof invokes that proposition to turn the constancy up to a precision obtained from the algebra into the Ramsey-type conclusion.

core_obligations: Forward direction, approximation: assume every finite family in the algebra is finitely oscillation stable, fix a finite set of colorings of the copies of a finite substructure, and choose for each coloring an element of the algebra within a small distance and a margin, so that the family of chosen elements is controlled by the hypothesis (source line 349).

Forward direction, transfer of constancy: apply finite oscillation stability to the chosen family, which gives a translate on which every chosen element is constant up to the margin, and hence every coloring of the set is constant up to twice the precision (source line 349).

Forward direction, conclusion: by the article's oscillation stability proposition, the constancy up to twice the precision on that translate becomes the existence of a copy of any finite substructure on which every coloring of the set is constant up to twice the precision, which is the Ramsey property up to twice the precision (source line 349).

Converse direction: assume the Ramsey property up to twice the precision, fix a finite family in the algebra and a precision, take a finite set of finite colorings it controls and apply the hypothesis to obtain a copy on which those colorings are constant, which gives the constancy of the family (source line 351).

proof_roadmap.step: Choose algebra elements close to the given finite colorings, apply finite oscillation stability to the chosen family, and read the constancy of the colorings up to twice the precision.
Invoke the oscillation stability proposition in its Ramsey form to turn that constancy into the existence of a copy of any finite substructure on which every coloring of the set is constant.
Converse: from the Ramsey property up to twice the precision, control the given finite family by finitely many finite colorings and read the required constancy off the copy.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 doi:10.5802/ahl.16 的 Proposition prop:OSRP（源 340-346 行，两个枚举项的印刷号为 3.4.1/3.4.2；证明 348-352 行）：设 F 是 Fraïssé 结构、A 是 RUCB(Aut(F)) 的单位左不变闭 C*-子代数，则「A 中每个有限族有限振荡稳定」⇔「对每个 ε>0，F 对 (A)_ε 中的着色有误差 2ε 内的 Ramsey 性质」。证明不是例行核验：正方向先用**逼近**把给定有限着色族换成 A 中的有限族（每个着色配一个距离 ε 内的代数元素与余量 η），把假设的振荡稳定性作用上去得到该平移上的常数性，再用同章振荡稳定命题的 Ramsey 形式把它翻成「任意有限子结构都有拷贝使族中着色一致」（349 行）；反方向从「误差 2ε 的 Ramsey 性质」出发，用**有限着色在 A 的 ε-球中稠密/规律性**把给定有限族控制成有限多个有限着色，再从拷贝读出所需常数性（351 行）。难点在两次「逼近—换元」以及 ε 与 2ε 的精度簿记。原文位置：正方向 349 行，反方向 351 行。
